_comment: Known Modrinth mislabels: mods marked server 'unsupported' upstream that are
in fact needed (or perfectly functional) on dedicated servers. Consulted at
Layer 1 precedence slot 2 (with the config allowlist) — a match always
installs. Matching: exact sha1, case-insensitive modId, or case-insensitive
filename prefix on the JAR basename.
flywheel/athena: rendering libraries that dedicated servers must still have
because Create/Chipped hard-require them (they no-op server-side).
